body:
Real, live-verified bug: tmux new-session was handed a single inline command string containing && which tmux re-parses via a new shell, causing any backtick inside ONBOARDING's own prose (the real `emily observe` citation) to be evaluated as real command substitution rather than staying literal text -- silently ran emily observe with no args every time a new detached session started, corrupting the onboarding prompt. Fixed by writing startup steps to a real script file and passing ONBOARDING through as an environment variable instead of interpolating it into shell source. Live-verified against stub emily/claude binaries in a real scratch tmux session: argv now receives both backtick spans intact, unexecuted. commit d8d23ad.

⚓ ☃
title: tmux-session.sh: fixed real command-substitution bug in the detached-session startup line
